units.source_text: 照例先访问五公主，和她闲谈往事。

en.t: As usual, he first visited the Fifth Princess and chatted with her about old times.

units.source_text: 五公主从无聊的往事讲起，琐琐屑屑，噜哩噜苏。

en.t: The Fifth Princess began with dull memories of the past, talking on and on in tedious detail.

units.source_text: 源氏公子但觉毫无兴趣，只是昏昏欲睡。

en.t: Prince Genji found it utterly uninteresting and only grew drowsy.

units.source_text: 五公主也打个呵欠，说道：“上了年纪，晚上只想睡，话也说不好了。”

en.t: The Fifth Princess yawned too and said, "When one grows old, at night one only wants to sleep, and one cannot even speak properly."

units.source_text: 才得说完，便发出一种奇怪的声音，大概是打眠鼾了。

en.t: No sooner had she finished speaking than she made a strange sound, probably a snore in her sleep.

units.source_text: 源氏公子求之不得，连忙起身告辞。

en.t: This was exactly what Prince Genji had wished for, so he hurriedly rose and took his leave.

units.source_text: 正欲出门，但见另一个年纪很大的老婆婆咳嗽着走进来了。

en.t: Just as he was about to go out, he saw another very old woman come in coughing.

units.source_text: 开言道：“说句对不起您的话。

en.t: She began, "Forgive me for saying this to you.

units.source_text: 我想您是知道我在这里的，我还静等您来看我呢。

en.t: I thought you knew I was here, and I was quietly waiting for you to come see me.

units.source_text: 原来您已经不把我这个人放在心上了！

en.t: So it turns out you no longer keep someone like me in your thoughts!

units.source_text: 桐壶爷常常喊着‘老祖母’和我说笑呢！”

en.t: Lord Kiritsubo often used to call me 'old grandmother' and joke with me!"

units.source_text: 她自道姓名，源氏公子便也记起了。

en.t: When she gave her name, Prince Genji remembered her as well.

units.source_text: 这个人以前称为源内侍。

en.t: This woman had formerly been known as Gen no Naishi.

units.source_text: 公子曾经听说她后来做了尼姑，当五公主的徒弟，在这里修行，想不到她还活着。

en.t: The prince had heard that she later became a nun, entered the Fifth Princess's discipleship, and practiced here, but he had not imagined she was still alive.

units.source_text: 源氏公子一向不想起这个人，今天突然看到，全然出乎意外。

en.t: Prince Genji had never thought of her, so seeing her suddenly today was completely unexpected.

units.source_text: 便答道：“父皇在世时的事，都已经变成古话了；我回想当年，不胜感慨。

en.t: He answered, "Everything from the time when my imperial father was alive has already become an old tale; when I think back on those years, I am deeply moved.

units.source_text: 今天能听到你的声音，我很高兴。

en.t: I am very glad to hear your voice today.

units.source_text: 请你把我看作‘没有父母亲而饿倒在地的旅人’，多多照顾我吧。”

en.t: Please regard me as 'a traveler without parents, collapsed on the ground from hunger,' and take good care of me."

units.source_text: 便走近她身旁来坐下。

en.t: Then he went over and sat down beside her.

units.source_text: 源内侍看看他的风姿，越发恋念往昔，照旧装出撒娇撒痴的姿态来。

en.t: Gen no Naishi looked at his graceful appearance, longed all the more for the past, and put on her old coquettish, foolish manner as before.

units.source_text: 她口中齿牙零落，讲话已很吃力，然而声音还是娇滴滴地，态度还是嘻皮笑脸。

en.t: Her teeth had fallen out and speaking was already difficult, yet her voice was still syrupy sweet and her manner still simpering.

units.source_text: 她对着公子唱起古歌来：“惯说他人老可憎，今知老已到我身。”

en.t: Facing the prince, she began to sing an old poem: "I used to say another's age was hateful; now I know old age has come to me."

units.source_text: 公子觉得讨厌，苦笑着想道：“这个人仿佛自以为以前一直不老，是现在忽然老起来的。”

en.t: The prince felt disgusted and thought with a bitter smile, "It is as if this woman believes she had never aged before and has only suddenly grown old now."

units.source_text: 然而反过来一想，又觉得此人很可怜。

en.t: Yet when he thought about it another way, he also felt that she was very pitiful.

units.source_text: 他回思往事：在这老婆婆青春时代，宫中争宠竞爱的女御和更衣，现在有的早已亡故，有的零落飘泊，生趣全无了。

en.t: He thought back over the past: in this old woman's youth, the court ladies and consorts who competed for favor and love in the palace had by now either died long ago or fallen into decline and wandering, with no joy left in life.

units.source_text: 就中像尼姑藤壶妃子那样盛年夭逝，更是意料不到之事。

en.t: Among them, that someone like Lady Fujitsubo, the nun, should die in the prime of life was especially unexpected.

units.source_text: 像五公主和这源内侍之类的人，残年所余无几，人品又毫不足道，却长生在世间，悠然自得地诵经念佛。

en.t: Yet people like the Fifth Princess and this Gen no Naishi, with little of their remaining years left and no particular worth in character, lived on in the world, leisurely and content as they chanted sutras and recited the Buddha's name.

units.source_text: 可知世事不定，天道无知！

en.t: This showed how uncertain worldly affairs were, and how unknowing the way of heaven was!

units.source_text: 他想到这里，脸上显出感慨的神色来。

en.t: As he thought this far, a look of deep feeling appeared on his face.

units.source_text: 源内侍以为他在怀念昔年对她的旧情了，便兴致勃然地吟道：

en.t: Gen no Naishi thought he was reminiscing about his former affection for her, and with rising spirits she chanted:
